# Write-free e2e: validate failures — exact error ids (examples + specs).

# examples/ invalids (5an.2 product surface).
! exec foundry validate --spec examples/invalid-unknown-field.toml
stderr 'spec.unknown_field'
assert_error_id stderr spec.unknown_field

! exec foundry validate --spec examples/invalid-bad-name.toml
stderr 'spec.invalid_field'
assert_error_id stderr spec.invalid_field

! exec foundry validate --spec examples/invalid-bad-profile.toml
stderr 'resolve.unknown_profile'
stderr 'available profiles'
assert_error_id stderr resolve.unknown_profile

# JSON form: envelope on stdout, empty stderr, stable error_id.
! exec foundry validate --spec examples/invalid-unknown-field.toml --output json
stdout 'spec.unknown_field'
stdout '"ok":false'
! stderr .
assert_error_id stdout spec.unknown_field

# specs/invalid Appendix D coverage (process boundary).
! exec foundry validate --spec specs/invalid/parse_error.toml
stderr 'spec.parse_error'
assert_error_id stderr spec.parse_error

! exec foundry validate --spec specs/invalid/unsupported_schema.toml
stderr 'spec.unsupported_schema'
assert_error_id stderr spec.unsupported_schema

! exec foundry validate --spec specs/invalid/unknown_field.toml
stderr 'spec.unknown_field'
assert_error_id stderr spec.unknown_field

! exec foundry validate --spec specs/invalid/duplicate_key.toml
stderr 'spec.duplicate_key'
assert_error_id stderr spec.duplicate_key

! exec foundry validate --spec specs/invalid/invalid_field.toml
stderr 'spec.invalid_field'
assert_error_id stderr spec.invalid_field

! exec foundry validate --spec specs/invalid/duplicate_profile.toml
stderr 'spec.duplicate_profile'
assert_error_id stderr spec.duplicate_profile

! exec foundry validate --spec specs/invalid/nested_unknown_table.toml
stderr 'spec.unknown_field'
assert_error_id stderr spec.unknown_field

! exec foundry validate --spec specs/invalid/hostile_env_destination.toml
stderr 'spec.invalid_field'
assert_error_id stderr spec.invalid_field

# Missing --spec is usage (exit 2).
! exec foundry validate
stderr 'usage.invalid|required flag|spec'
